structured.answer: I'd go with the second one, the one where each company comes as its own block (I saw הראל, then מור), with all its tracks underneath and one line on top saying how many tracks, how much money and what management fee it takes. The first one put "עוקב מדד s&p 500" first, and I don't know what that is. I never got as far as the third one, the one marked "מומלץ".

stuck.where: Screen 1, the buttons 'החברה בראש השורה', 'קיבוץ לפי חברה', 'טבלת חברות מול סוגים'
stuck.why: I didn't know which drawing I was looking at. Also the button says 'מחשב / טלפון' and I didn't know if I should press something.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Too many buttons with words I don't know (s&p 500, עוקב מדד, גמיש, כספי (שקלי)). I didn't know where to start.
It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500', English letters. It felt like shares and gambling, not saving.

stuck.where: Screens 4-6, the tracks of הראל and מור
stuck.why: Each row has many numbers, little circles and two colours. I couldn't tell what the percentages next to 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' mean, and after six screens I was tired and stopped.

findings.what: A black background with grey writing that's small and pale. Even with my glasses on, my eyes get tired.
findings.where: Every screen, especially the column headings and the explanation lines

findings.what: The first option opens with English letters, 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'. It made me feel the page isn't for me.
Too many numbers in each row: two management fees, two exposure figures, two returns, assets and a fund number. It makes me anxious.
The yellow and green circles look almost the same to me, and I don't know what they say.
There are two management fees ('מההפקדות' and 'מהחיסכון') and it doesn't say which one counts for me.
Some companies I've never heard of (אינפיניטי, ילין לפידות, מור, איילון). I wouldn't give them money.
A huge number of buttons for picking a product and a type. I didn't know what to press.
The page is very long. The option marked 'מומלץ' is far down and I never reached it.
